en: Colorized historical street scene showing a broad urban boulevard lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the street, along with a tram and horse‑drawn carriages. Shop signs in Hungarian are visible on the ground floors, including a café on the right corner building. At the top in red letters it identifies the city and the boulevard.
